Sundrug Co., Ltd. is a major Japanese drugstore chain
that does not manufacture its own major brand catalog. Instead, it acts as a massive retailer and distributor for top Japanese and international manufacturers of over-the-counter medicines, cosmetics, health supplements, and daily necessities, alongside its own private-label line called
SUNSTYLE
サンドラッグ Online Store
Major Brands and Manufacturers Sold
Pharmaceuticals & Health:
Otsuka Pharmaceutical (Nature Made, OS-1), Hisamitsu Pharmaceutical (Salonpas), Rohto Pharmaceutical, Kobayashi Pharmaceutical, Taisho Pharmaceutical, and Yakult.
Cosmetics & Skincare:
Shiseido, Kanebo, Kose, Sofina, Hada Labo, DHC, Canmake, and Deonatulle.
Daily Necessities & Body Care:
Kao (Biore, 8x4), L'Oréal, and Maybelline.
Private Label:
SUNSTYLE
, which covers in-house branded supplements, health foods, and household goods.
